Disconnect Battery Negative Terminal

s2.ptxt: Remove the 2 front wiper arm head caps.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Wiper Arm & Blade Assembly RH

s2.ptxt: Remove the front wiper arm nut and front wiper arm & blade assembly RH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Wiper Arm & Blade Assembly LH

s2.ptxt: Remove the front wiper arm nut and front wiper arm & blade assembly LH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Hood to Cowl Top Seal

s2.ptxt: Disengage the 7 clips and remove the hood to cowl top seal.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Side Panel Protector NO.1 LH

s2.ptxt: Disengage the pin and remove front side panel protector NO.1 LH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Cowl Top Ventilator Louver LH

s2.ptxt: Disengage the 11 claws and remove the cowl top ventilator louver LH as shown in the illustration.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Side Panel Protector NO.1 RH

s2.ptxt: Disengage the pin and remove front side panel protector NO.1 RH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Cowl Top Ventilator Louver RH

s2.ptxt: Disengage the 5 claws and remove the cowl top ventilator louver RH as shown in the illustration.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Windshield Wiper Motor & Link Assembly

s2.ptxt: Remove the 2 bolts and disconnect the windshield wiper motor & link assembly.
Disconnect the connector and clamp, and remove the windshield wiper motor & link assembly as shown in the illustration.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Cowl Body Mounting Reinforcement RH

s2.ptxt: Remove the 3 bolts and remove the cowl body mounting reinforcement RH from the cowl top panel outer.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Cowl Top Panel Outer

s2.ptxt: Disconnect the windshield deicer wire harness connector and disengage the 3 clamps, and detach them from the cowl top panel outer. (w/ Cold Area Specification)
Disengage the clamps of the heater air duct splash shield seal No.2 and water guard plate RH, and bend each as shown in the illustration.
Remove the 8 bolts and the cowl top panel outer.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Engine Cover Sub-assembly NO.1

s2.ptxt: Remove the 2 nuts and engine cover assembly No.1.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Air Cleaner Cap w/ Air Cleaner Hose

s2.ptxt: Disconnect the ventilation hose.
Disconnect the vacuum switching valve connector and clamp, and disconnect the wire harness.
Disconnect the fuel vapor feed hose and fuel vapor feed hose No.2.
Disconnect the intake air flow meter connector and clamp, and disconnect the wire harness from the air cleaner cap.
Lock air cleaner hose clamp No.1.
With the clamp locked, remove the air cleaner cap w/ air cleaner hose.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Throttle Body Assembly

s2.ptxt: Disconnect the throttle body connector.
Disconnect the water bypass hose, water bypass hose No.2, throttle body hose and purge line hose.
Remove the 4 bolts and remove the throttle body assembly.
Remove the gasket from the intake manifold.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Fuel Tube Sub-assembly

s2.ptxt: Remove the EFI fuel pipe clamp No.2.
Using SST, disconnect the fuel tube (for the procedure, refer to ).

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Oxygen Sensor

s2.ptxt: Disconnect the oxygen sensor connector and clamp.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Fuel Delivery Pipe w/ Injector

atten3.ptxt: Do not drop the fuel injectors when removing and installing the delivery pipe.

s2.ptxt: Disconnect the throttle body connector.
Disconnect the 4 injector connectors.
Disconnect the oil control valve connector. (*1)
Disengage the 3 clamps and disconnect the wire harness from the delivery pipe. (*2)
Remove the 2 bolts and remove the fuel delivery pipe w/ injector.
Remove the 2 spacers from the cylinder head.
Remove the 4 insulators from the cylinder head.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Fuel Injector Assembly

s2.ptxt: Remove the fuel injectors from the fuel delivery pipe.
Remove the O-rings from the injectors.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Check Valve to Connector Tube Hose

s2.ptxt: Slide the clamp and disconnect the check valve to connector tube hose.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Ventilation Hose NO.2

s2.ptxt: Slide the clamp and disconnect ventilation hose No.2.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Intake Manifold

s2.ptxt: Disconnect the check valve to connector tube hose from the vacuum hose clamp. (*1)
Remove the 5 bolts and 2 nuts and remove the intake manifold. 。
Remove the gasket from the intake manifold.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Check Valve to Connector Tube Hose

s2.ptxt: Slide the clamp and remove the check valve to connector tube hose.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Ventilation Hose NO.2

s2.ptxt: Slide the clamp and remove the ventilation hose No.2.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Throttle Body Hose

s2.ptxt: Remove the throttle body hose.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Vacuum Hose Clamp

s2.ptxt: Remove the bolt and remove the vacuum hose clamp.
